scope: Evidence transcript only; not an executable or complete combat profile.
open_items: The printed dash for Karma is retained verbatim rather than converted to a number.
Damage reduction dashes are retained verbatim.
The character page names a submachine gun; its range and close-range trouble come from the separate weapon rules.
Most powers and some traits are not yet covered by an audited combat engine.
Printed official damage formulas are not the literal Marvel-dice pool used by the table.
